0.content: Landrich's expedition to the ruins on Dragonspine, known from three journals found during A Land Entombed. The party, young aristocrats and servants, set out from South Base Camp. Companions vanished in a snowstorm; a cave-in before a round door killed another and cost the party its food and fuel. Eberhart then led Ingbert and Luther into the cellar of the southwestern ruins and attacked them with a polearm. Luther survived long enough to write the third journal. See the entries for Luther and Eberhart.
